mapper.select: INSERT INTO transfer_transaction (tenant_id, run_id, plate_barcode, source_resource_id, target_resource_id, status) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{runId}, #{plateBarcode}, #{sourceResourceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{targetResourceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, 'REPORTED') RETURNING id
SELECT plate_barcode AS "plateBarcode", target_resource_id AS "targetResourceId" FROM transfer_transaction WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND status IN ('REPORTED', 'UNKNOWN')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO position_evidence (tenant_id, plate_barcode, resource_id, evidence_type, operator, note) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{plateBarcode}, #{resourceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{evidenceType}, #{operator, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{note, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
